breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the contribution of the average normal stress to the in-plane shear state; the maximum in-plane shear depends on both σ_avg and τ_avg.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly omits the erroneous instruction to use only the transverse shear stress alone for the maximum in-plane shear. Instead, it correctly specifies the formula τ_max = sqrt((σ_avg/2)^2 + τ_avg^2), which includes both σ_avg and τ_avg contributions, matching the ground truth prompt.
